notes.title: Silenthead new enemies and rooms!
notes.notes:
Hi! 
We made a first Early access update which includes:

[list]
[*] 6 new enemies 
     [list]
     [*]RageHead - strong enemy, shows vision rage.
     [*]RageHead (shielded)- strong enemy, shows vision rage with shield.
     [*]Kolo - light enemy with bigger HP pool then regular Woodhands.
     [*]Masked Kolo - light enemy with bigger HP pool and grater damage.
     [*]Saw Hemp - combined Saw and hemp enemies.
     [*]Larva's Head - the head of the larva.
     [/list]
[*] 6 new rooms
     [list]
     [*]2 new rooms in the 2 stage of 1 Tower
     [*]2 new rooms in the 2 stage of 2 Tower
     [*]1 new rooms in the 2 stage of 3 Tower
     [*]1 new rooms in the 2 stage of 4 Tower
     [/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Thanks you for reaching us!
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! Several of you reached to us with questions about the name of the game and about Sirenhead author. 

We started our project as a twin stick shooter with some SCP creatures as bosses, one of them was Sirenhead. We didn't know that it has an author, so we decide to remove it from the game for now. We mailed @slimyswampghost about this issue and are waiting for his response. We don't want to steal someones work, just want to make our small project. Hope we did not offend anyone. Thanks.
